rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual intensifier for strong effects such as being profoundly troubled.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 ling6 ngo5 hou2 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for an emotional or lasting sense of being deeply affected, rather than just very affected.

example.english: What they said profoundly moved me.
example.traditional: 佢嗰番說話深深咁打動咗我。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 faan1 syut3 waa6 sam1 sam1 gam3 daa2 dung6 zo2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when someone thinks, analyses, or writes with depth and meaning rather than merely with strong intensity.

example.english: They profoundly analysed this problem and made a lot of sense.
example.traditional: 佢深入咁分析呢個問題，講得好有道理。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sam1 jap6 gam3 fan1 sik1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5
